detail.longDescription:
Why can't #Docker have just one command to clean up all the wasteful disk space it consumes?

docker system prune -a -v
docker builder prune
docker ps -f status=exited -q | xargs -r docker rm
docker images -f dangling=true -q | xargs -r docker rmi

Arcane mystic spells to reclaim 160+ GB space. 🙄 And that probably isn't even all of them!

Docker especially for dev environments is so wasteful; every tiny app change & dozens of overlay FS containers just sit there forever taking up disk space.
